profile.headline: Software Engineer II at Microsoft
profile.summary: I am a software developer with 5 years of industry experience currently working at Microsoft in the Azure identity space. Since my graduation from the University of Notre Dame in 2018 (B.S. in computer science), I've worked in many software ecosystems across two jobs with Epic and now Microsoft, including desktop and mobile apps, web development, and cloud services. I'm an experienced problem solver in numerous programming languages spanning all levels of the development stack. I have both project and team leadership experience, I am a hard worker with exemplary attention to detail, and I am a curious, fast learner who's always eager to take on a new challenge.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
At Microsoft, I am currently a developer on the Entra Connect Cloud Sync team in the hybrid identity space. During my time here so far, I've contributed to a wide variety of projects and initiatives, and I've grown and learned a tremendous amount in the process, earning a promotion in my first full year on the team. My work so far has included:

 - Leading the engineering side of an effort to help customers migrate off of a deprecated version of our product, which completed with minimal support case impact and won an internal customer service award
 - Improving service-to-service communication reliability using failover pairs of data centers, which reduced the volume of some of our service's most common error codes by over 90%
 - Implementing scale-down rules to automatically reduce our cloud service's machine allocations in less busy regions and during less busy times, which immediately reduced service COGS by half
 - Developing new full-stack sync features that enabled customers to synchronize new attributes and object types from their on-premises directories into the cloud (including work for the UI experience of the new features)
 - Leading multiple incident postmortems and completing repair items to improve service reliability, telemetry, and the quality of the on-call engineer experience
 - Volunteering for an initiative to improve the reliability of my team's check-in test suite to make a clean test pass a hard requirement for every code change
 - Leading monthly virtual social events for the team to build camaraderie even with most team members working remotely
positions.insights: Skills: Cloud Applications · Software Infrastructure · Microsoft Azure · C# · Project Management

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
During my time at Epic as a developer on the Orders team, I experienced tremendous growth in both my leadership and development skills. I led by example throughout my tenure, from finishing training more than a month ahead of schedule to becoming a Team Lead with my own pod of developers before hitting the two-year mark. My contributions spanned many functional areas and all levels of Epic's design process and development stack, notably including:

 - Leading an effort motivated by COVID-19 to give nurses access to the same mobile ordering tools available to doctors (iOS, Objective-C, and Swift)
 - Building tools to inform doctors placing orders about low-cost alternatives and potential duplicates (.NET Framework client code, InterSystems Cache databse code)
 - Mentoring new hires and leading a team of four developers during the early days of the COVID-19 pandemic, keeping projects on track during the transition to virtual meetings and remote work
 - Managing customer relations through meetings, webinars, and onsite visits to gather feedback on project priorities and generate excitement about upcoming releases
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · .NET Framework · Team Management · Software Design · Web Applications

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description: As an intern on the Warehouse and Fulfillment Technology Team at Shopbop, a subsidiary of Amazon, I created a new service that assigns priority values to all customer orders entering the warehouse. I utilized a variety of tools and packages throughout the development process, and I gained valuable new experience with Java programming, web development, and the Scrum process framework.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: At Molex I worked with the Software Solutions team on a few different Python utilities for various groups of engineers. These included a neural network topology tester, a Word document auto-generator, and a graphical data comparison tool. I also worked with an intern team on an innovation initiative that was presented to both Molex and Koch leadership.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description: During my summer at Elevance I worked with the IT team, from whom I learned a lot about managing a large network of computers. My projects included improving inventory records, updating SharePoint sites, and optimizing Microsoft CRM reports to organize information for executives.
